title: Post metadata (caption, hashtags, audio) — shared by every template

topic.description: Short internal topic label, e.g. 'present perfect vs past simple'

caption.description: Instagram caption. Turkish first, then 1–2 English lines. Hook line, 2–4 short lines of value, 1 question for comments, 1 CTA (kaydet / paylaş / link in bio).

hashtags.description: Mix of Turkish and English hashtags. Always include #ahkakademi and #ingilizce.

audio_mood.description: Suggested trending-audio mood, e.g. 'upbeat suspense build with a drop at the reveal'
